🚌 Getting There
🚆
By train & foot
~20 min walk from Delft Central Station. Bus 69 (direction TU Campus), 455 (direction Zoetermeer via Station), 172 (direction Station Alexander), or 40 (direction Rotterdam Centraal) to bus stop “Delft, Aula”.

By car — free parking
Park at any TU Delft car park. Tap your bank card or OV-chipkaart at the barrier to enter.

⭐ Gold Sponsors
IC'Alps
⌄
IC'Alps is a fabless ASIC/SoC design and supply company based in Grenoble, France, specializing in custom integrated circuits for demanding applications. Their expertise spans ultra-low power design, sensor and MEMS analog interfaces, mixed-signal circuits, and power management — capabilities that are directly relevant to the miniaturization and performance requirements of active implantable medical devices.

As a Gold Sponsor, IC'Alps will be participating in the Industry Panel Discussion and will have a dedicated exhibition booth at the event — stop by and connect with their team to learn more about their technology!
Microdul
⌄
Microdul is a Swiss electronics manufacturing specialist with deep expertise in miniaturized electronic modules for medical devices and active implants. Their capabilities span ASIC design, SMD, BGA and flip-chip assembly, wire bonding, and bare die packaging in Class 5 cleanroom — covering every step from engineering to production. Their work is embedded in the daily lives of patients worldwide, with their miniaturized PCBAs at the core of 15 Class 3 active implantable medical devices.

As a Gold Sponsor, Microdul will be participating in the Industry Panel Discussion and will have a dedicated exhibition booth at the event — stop by and connect with their team to learn more about their technology!

We look forward to the expertise and perspective they will bring to the conversation.
Osypka Medical
⌄
Osypka is a Germany-based medical technology company with decades of experience in the design, development, and contract manufacturing of active implantable medical devices. From their origins in pacemaker electrode innovation to their current work across cardiology, neurostimulation, and orthopaedics, Osypka offers end-to-end expertise from prototyping through regulatory approval and high-volume production.

As a Gold Sponsor, Osypka will be participating in the Industry Panel Discussion and will have a dedicated exhibition booth at the event — stop by and connect with their team to learn more about their technology!
Cisteo Medical / Tame-Care
⌄
CISTEO Medical is a French contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) based in Besançon, specializing in the design, manufacture, and regulatory approval of medical devices up to Class III, including active implants. Tame-Care complements this with a comprehensive range of services covering electronics design, technological consulting, testing, and supply chain management. Together, they bring a strong and complementary set of capabilities that are highly relevant to the active implantable medical device community providing end-to-end support across the full medical device development lifecycle.

As Gold Sponsors, Cisteo MEDICAL and Tame-Care will participate in the Industry Panel Discussion and will have a dedicated exhibition booth at the event — stop by and connect with their teams to learn more about what they offer!
Femtoprint
⌄
Femtoprint specializes in high-precision 3D glass microfabrication using ultrafast laser technology (Selective Laser Etching), enabling the development of complex microfluidic devices, micro-optical systems, and miniaturized components for medical and high-tech applications. Their technologies are particularly relevant for implantable medical devices, microfluidics, and high-reliability biomedical systems.

As a Gold Sponsor, Femtoprint will be participating in the Industry Panel Discussion and will have a dedicated exhibition booth at the event — stop by and connect with their team to learn more about their technology!
SCT Ceramics
⌄
SCT Ceramics specializes in advanced ceramic technologies and high-performance materials for demanding medical and industrial applications, supporting the development of reliable and durable components for next-generation medical devices and implantable systems. Their expertise in precision ceramic manufacturing and advanced materials plays an important role in enabling safer, smaller, and more reliable active implantable medical devices.

As a Gold Sponsor, SCT Ceramics will participate in the Industry Panel Discussion and will also have a dedicated exhibition booth during the event — a great opportunity to connect with their team and learn more about their technologies and capabilities.
